description: The heaviest thing the sim can do, and rare on purpose: a citywide ESP. ⚠ The ESP is a SINGLETON in plugins/emergency, so only one incident may ever hold it — the step declines rather than joining somebody else's lockdown.
name: Emergency protocol

stage.text: An emergency security protocol is in effect across the Basin — all residents are instructed to shelter in place until further notice.

stage.message: ⚠ EMERGENCY SECURITY PROTOCOL ACTIVE — SHELTER IN PLACE — ARMED RESPONSE UNITS ARE DEPLOYED — THIS IS NOT A DRILL ⚠

lines: The siren is the only thing on this street that is not hiding.
Every door on the row is shut and the red light goes over them, and over again.
Nothing is moving out here except the light.

stage.text: They put the whole Basin under protocol over {place}. Whatever happened up there, they are not calling it a fight.
